An easy way to make that rich, restaurant-style flavour right at home. Quick mushroom tikka, a smooth makhani gravy, and a final tempering where everything comes together to create an incredibly delicious Tikka Masala.
If you’re a mushroom lover or a fan of tikka masala, you definitely need to try this one. The full written recipe is pinned in the comment section below in the description. Happy Cooking!
